abstract: Epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT) is a rare type of gestational trophoblastic disease and only 25 cases have been reported so far. It was first proposed by Mazur and Kurman in 1994 as an unusual type of trophoblastic tumor that is distinct from placental site trophoblastic tumor and choriocarcinoma and has features resembling carcinoma. A case of ETT of the lung in a 38-year-old Japanese woman is reported. The patient had suffered from a hydatidiform mole at the age of 27 years, and had four normal deliveries at the ages of 24, 31, 35 and 37 years. Because no tumor lesions were detected in the uterus, the patient was suspected of having metastatic choriocarcinoma with multiple lesions in the lung accompanied by an elevated level of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG). In order to make an exact diagnosis, a partial resection of metastatic foci in the lung was performed. Microscopically, the tumor showed hemorrhagic necrotic foci and was composed of mainly mononuclear tumor cells and some giant tumor cells resembling trophoblastic cells. Immunohistochemical examination showed that a few large cells were stained positively for hCG, and that other cells were positive for human placental lactogen, pregnancy-specific beta1-glycoprotein, cytokeratin 7 and inhibin-alpha. In the ultrastructure, the tumor cells contained large nuclei and rich organella with desmosomes and well-formed filaments. The diagnosis of ETT was confirmed from the findings as described above.
abstract_ja: 類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍(ETT)は妊娠性絨毛性疾患のまれな型で、これまで報告例は25例にすぎない。1994年に Mazur と Kurman により、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍や絨毛癌とは異なり、癌腫に類似した特徴を持つ非典型的な栄養膜腫瘍として提唱された。今回、38歳の日本人女性の肺原発 ETT の症例を報告する。この患者は27歳時に胞状奇胎の既往があり、24、31、35、37歳時に正常分娩を4回経験していた。子宮に腫瘍病変が認められなかったため、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の上昇を伴う、肺の多発病変を有する転移性絨毛癌が疑われた。確定診断のため、肺の転移巣の部分切除が施行された。顕微鏡的には、腫瘍は出血性壊死巣を伴い、主に単核の腫瘍細胞と、栄養膜細胞に類似した一部の巨細胞からなっていた。免疫組織化学的検査では、少数の大型細胞が hCG に陽性で、その他の細胞はヒト胎盤性ラクトゲン、妊娠特異的β1グリコプロテイン、サイトケラチン7、インヒビンαに陽性であった。超微細構造では、腫瘍細胞は大きな核と、デスモソームおよび発達した線維を伴う豊富な細胞小器官を有していた。上記の所見から ETT の診断が確定した。
